fusions.name: Tagged Quarry
fusions.desc: A light touch on one enemy up to 3 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: You close up to 7 tiles on a fleeing enemy and grip its throat, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Close for the Kill
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent of Weakness
fusions.desc: Against enemies at low health, you deal 12% more damage.
